notes.title: Update Ver1.10
notes.notes: [p]Fixed compatibility issue to work with SteamDeck.[/p][p]The top menu will not be displayed in SteamDeck's BigPicture mode. [b][i]The in-game language will be determined by the Steam client's language settings (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese).[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
